もっとユリアはめちゃくちゃで、迷惑ばっかりかけて……\nそれでも、心の底からすべ: The old Julia was much more reckless, doing nothing but causing trouble... Yet even so, you were someone who could enjoy fighting from the bottom of your heart.
何度だって無理だと思うようなことがあっても、\nユリアについていけばなんとかなっ: No matter how many times we ran into situations that seemed impossible, as long as we followed you, everything worked out in the end, didn't it?
というか、ゴチャゴチャ考えるの似合ってないわよ？\nユリアはもっと今しかない、め: Or rather, overthinking things really doesn't suit you, you know? It's much better for Julia to be reckless, free, and living in the moment.
苦しくても、痛くても怖くても……今のめるは気にしてない。: Even if it's painful, even if it hurts, even if it's scary... the current Meru doesn't care.
ただ、今この瞬間……仲間を守る。\nそのために全力を尽くす。ただ、それだけのため: Right now, in this very moment... she's protecting her friends. Giving it her all for that sole purpose. She's pushing herself just for that.
ユリア。そんなめるを見てどう思う？\n過去のめるに比べて不格好だと思うか？: Julia. Looking at Meru right now, what do you think? Do you think she looks ungraceful compared to the past Meru?
……ううん。そんなことない……凄く、カッコいい。: ...No. Not at all... She looks really, really cool.
そうだ！ それがめるの在り方なんだ！\nめるは、己の過去には拘っていない！: That's right! That is Meru's way of being! Meru isn't clinging to her own past!
ユリア、お前はどうだ！？\n仲間に……勝ちに拘るお前は、本当にお前らしくあるのか: Julia, what about you!? You, who are obsessed with your friends... obsessed with winning—are you really being true to yourself!?
そうそう、なんだか難しいことを言ってたけど、シンプルな話よ♪: Yeah yeah, he was saying all sorts of complicated things, but it's actually really simple♪
俺の言葉に続けるように、\n回線をつないだ翠蘭とアニスがユリアへと語りかけた。: Following up on my words, Suiran and Anise, who connected to the line, spoke to Julia.
ずっと私はユリアを見て来ました。\nそのユリアのためだったら、どこにだって行きま: I've been watching you all this time, Julia. If it's for that version of you, I'll go anywhere.
あたしは無視されるのが一番イヤって知ってるでしょ？\nだから、ユリアが嫌がるまで: You know I hate being ignored more than anything, right? So I'll keep following you until you get sick of me♪
こういってくれる仲間がいるんだ。なに、失敗しても死ぬだけだ！\nだから……何も恐: You have friends who say things like that for you. So what if you fail? It just means you die! That's why... charge right in without fearing a thing, Julia!
流石にそれは暴論過ぎませんか？\n……まあ、でもそうですね。失敗しても一緒です。: Isn't that a bit too extreme of an argument? ...Well, but I suppose you're right. Even if we fail, we'll be together.
……いいの？ 失敗しちゃっても……？: ...Is it really okay? Even if I mess up...?
あら？ たまにそういうおちゃめを見せるのは可愛いものじゃない？\nふふ、ユリアっ: My? Isn't it cute when you show a bit of clumsiness like that once in a while? Fufu, Julia, you're so cute when you're scared.
煽らないでください、アニス。\nユリアを見捨てる事なんてありませんよ。: Please don't fan the flames, Anise. We would never abandon Julia.
ふふ、見捨てるなんてありえないわよね。\n地の底で死ぬときだって一緒に居てあげる: Fufu, abandoning you is out of the question. Even if we die at the bottom of the earth, I'll stay right beside you♪
アニスが言うと冗談にならない気がしますね……: When Anise says it, I feel like it stops being a joke...
ユリア、お前が持ってる気持ちや感情は受け入れろ。\nお前がやるべきは……振り回さ: Julia, accept the feelings and emotions you have. What you need to do... is to stop letting them pull you around and bind you.
あるがままの自分を受け入れ……そして、ユリアらしく、\n全力で今の時間を楽しむん: Accept yourself as you are... and then, just like Julia, enjoy this moment with everything you've got.
そして、翠蘭とアニスの通信が切れる。\n恐らくは、その余裕すらなくなったのだろう: And then, the communications from Suiran and Anise cut off. Most likely, they no longer had the breathing room to even maintain the call.
……あはは。みんな、好き勝手に言ってくれて……\n私だって、悩んで考えてたのに。: ...Ahaha. Everyone just says whatever they want... even though I was over here worrying and thinking so hard about it.
カオスメイデンらしいじゃないか。: Isn't that just how Chaos Maiden is?
……うん。そうだね。\nみーんな、自分勝手に好きな事をやるのが私達だったね: ...Yeah. You're right. Everyone doing whatever selfish things they wanted— that was who we were all along.
翠蘭ちゃんは信じてくれるって言ってた。\nアニスちゃんだって一緒にいてくれるって: Suiran-chan said she'd believe in me. And Anise-chan said she'd stay with me.
……私、多分信じてなかったんだ。\n私がずっと走ってたら、みんなを置いて独りぼっ: ...I guess I just didn't believe it. I thought that if I kept running ahead, I'd leave everyone behind and end up all alone.
確かにそういう関係性もあるだろうな。\n……でも、カオスメイデンはそうじゃないだ: Sure, there are relationships like that. ...But Chaos Maiden isn't like that, right?
――そうだね。うん、そうだ。\n私が怖かったのは……痛いことでも失敗でもないんだ: —Yeah. Mm, that's right. What I was scared of... wasn't pain or failure.
ただ、皆に幻滅されたくない……負けて、嫌な空気になりたくない。\nそんな風に自分: I just didn't want everyone to be disillusioned with me... I didn't want to lose and ruin the mood. I was just cornering myself like that, wasn't I?
そんなことで幻滅しないって、\nカオスメイデンの皆はとっくに受け入れてくれてたの: Even though everyone in Chaos Maiden had long accepted me and would never lose faith over something like that...
『おぼえてないことを思い出すのはたいへん。\nでも、おぼえてることなら、きっとす: 'Trying to remember things you forgot is hard. But if it's something you already know, you'll definitely remember it soon.'
……あはは、リディアちゃんの言ってた通りじゃん。\nただ、私が楽しいことを忘れた: ...Ahaha, it's just like Lydia-chan said. I had simply forgotten how to have fun.
お、どうした？ 壊れたか？: Oh, what's wrong? Did you break?
あはは……うん、壊れちゃった……縛ってるもの全部！\nだって、悩まなくたって……: Ahaha... yeah, I broke... everything that was binding me! After all, even if I don't worry... everyone will follow me anyway!
そうしたら、分かったんだ！\nただめちゃくちゃに、自分の楽しいって思うようにする: Once I realized that, I understood! I should just go completely wild and do whatever I feel is fun!
だからさ、死んじゃっても後悔しないよ……\nだってさ……私、今がすっごく楽しいん: So, you know, even if I die, I won't regret it... Because... I'm having so much fun right now!
ああ、精一杯遊んで来い！: Yeah, go play with everything you've got!
俺の言葉に猛然と敵前へと出撃するユリア。\n――その動きに、もはや迷いなどはなか: At my words, Julia fiercely heads out right in front of the enemy. There was no longer any hesitation in her movements.
